capabilities: Auto-fill Kanban columns with tasks from vault-wide Tasks filter rules
Complete tasks by dragging cards into a done column
Write completion status and date back to the task's source note
Generate the next instance of recurring tasks on completion
Auto-archive cards completed before today into Kanban's native archive
disambiguation: Not a standalone kanban board; it only adds auto-filled query columns to boards created with the existing Kanban plugin.
extras: Distributed via BRAT or manual download; README includes a full Chinese translation; cards inside smart columns must not be edited manually, and disabling source links disables write-back and drag-out undo.
intentEvidence: It augments the Kanban plugin you may already use, turning selected columns into live views of your Tasks queries.
problem: Kanban boards in Obsidian hold only manually added cards, so tasks spread across the vault never appear on a board and completing them there does not touch the source note.
